definitions.explanation: The wheel used to steer a car or other motor vehicle.
The bar used to steer a bicycle or motorcycle.
A part of an object designed to be held or operated by hand.

examples.english: I turned the steering wheel to the right.

examples.japanese: ハンドル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}って→握る：02383_nigiru⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}する→運転する：01335_unten⟧。
examples.english: To grip the steering wheel and drive.

notes:
ハンドル is a loanword from English "handle."

DRIVING EXPRESSIONS:
- ハンドル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to turn the steering wheel)
- ハンドル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧ (to grip the steering wheel)
- ハンドル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ (to turn the steering wheel)
- ハンドル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}す→離す：19372_hanasu⟧ (to let go of the steering wheel)

RIGHT-HAND DRIVE:
In Japan, cars have ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧ハンドル (right-hand drive), with the steering wheel on the right side.
